uncultured.finding: A 2016 Facebook screenshot preserves full thread context, reactions, timestamps, nested replies and phone chrome rather than cropping to the target sentence. It is an earlier same-platform instance of context-preserving evidentiary capture.
uncultured.assessment: useful longitudinal confirmation, but still the same platform family; not promoted to general visual grammar
uncultured.next: seek non-Facebook screenshots from other years and purposes

terminus.finding: The 2008 heritage-management paper by Fang-Chieh Jung and Chao-Ching Fu provides a counterweight to the current function-versus-tool hypothesis. It argues that importing ROT/OT outsourcing mechanisms not designed specifically for heritage preservation can produce different management outcomes; the institutional instrument can reshape the management function itself rather than merely serve as a replaceable channel.
terminus.quality: formal peer-reviewed article; clear problem, explicit analytical framework, empirical cases; high conceptual and evidentiary utility for falsification
terminus.candidate: refine the vein from 'tools change while function persists' to 'sometimes a function survives tool replacement, but some tools reconfigure the function because the instrument carries its own institutional logic'
terminus.next: continue searching for cases that distinguish channel substitution from institutional redesign
